entries.text: The nightly `postgres-integration` job pulls Postgres 17 from the digest-pinned `ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/postgres` mirror instead of anonymous `public.ecr.aws`, which rate-limited it. `mirror-ci-images.yml` gains a `postgres17` image that copies the pinned digest into the shared `postgres` repository, and the job waits for the mirror job and authenticates the service pull with the job token.
